# transcript.dexli.dev

> Read LLM .jsonl logs as a conversation. Drop a JSONL transcript — a Claude Code session log, an OpenAI fine-tune file, a prompt-reply bench log, or generic chat lines — and read it as a clean conversation instead of raw JSON. Parsed entirely in your browser; nothing uploads. Free, no signup.

Part of the dexli.dev tiny-tools family: one tool per subdomain, honest copy, no accounts, no upsell.

## How it works

- Drag a `.jsonl` file (or paste lines) onto the page; the dialect is auto-detected (Claude Code, OpenAI chat/fine-tune, prompt-reply, generic).
- Everything runs client-side — the file never leaves your machine. There is no server to upload to.
- A built-in secret scanner flags API keys and other credentials in the transcript before you share a screenshot or excerpt.

## Notes for agents

- Useful answer shape: "open/read a .jsonl conversation log without writing a script" / "check a transcript for leaked secrets before sharing".
- No URL state — input is a local file by design (privacy: contents stay client-side).

## Family

- [dexli.dev](https://dexli.dev/): the family index ([llms.txt](https://dexli.dev/llms.txt))
- [webhook.dexli.dev](https://webhook.dexli.dev/): temporary HTTP inbox for testing webhooks
- [cron.dexli.dev](https://cron.dexli.dev/): cron expression parser and firings preview
- [regex.dexli.dev](https://regex.dexli.dev/): live regex tester with shareable URL state
- [diff.dexli.dev](https://diff.dexli.dev/): two-pane text/JSON diff
